question: Should `photoscrawl classify` accept arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoint URLs, or should this new provider path be constrained or documented as local-only before merge?
rationale: The PR adds a user-facing endpoint flag on a Photos-derived media path; preserving photoscrawl's local-first boundary requires maintainer intent on whether non-loopback endpoints are allowed and how users are warned.

options.title: Merge after local-only guard or explicit warning
options.body: Keep the LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible provider, but require loopback validation or clear CLI/README language that non-local endpoints receive already-local image bytes.

options.title: Allow arbitrary endpoints as advanced opt-in
options.body: Accept the privacy risk as intentional and document that users may point the classifier at remote OpenAI-compatible servers.

options.title: Keep core Ollama-only for now
options.body: Do not add this provider path until a broader local-model provider policy is established.

recommendation.title: Merge after local-only guard or explicit warning
recommendation.body: Keep the LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible provider, but require loopback validation or clear CLI/README language that non-local endpoints receive already-local image bytes.

likelyOwner.reason: joshp123 introduced the local multimodal classifier and most of the current classify command/product boundary being extended.
